title: 第27章 你想怎么玩，姐都配合……
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
“晴姐，别闹了，路上还有别的车呢。”李大壮还不想被人围观。

    “那我们去个僻静的地方？”徐晴眉目含水，春意荡漾的看着李大壮，玉手动作不停，惹得李大壮“火冒三丈”！

    “要是晴姐不着急回店里做生意，倒也不是不行！”李大壮还真想体验下……

    谁知徐晴却在他大腿根轻掐了一下，媚声嗔道：“臭小子，先放过你，等姐把正事儿办完，再好好收拾你！”

    李大壮有些无语，自己都准备提枪上马了，你却放弃战斗了，这叫啥事儿啊！

    幸好后面徐晴没再撩拨他，一路疾驰，很快到了县城一处高档住宅区外的商业街上，将车停在其中一家名为“晴日鲜果行”的水果店。

    “这儿就是我们连锁水果店的总部，我的办公室在三楼，快跟我来！”

    徐晴迫不及待的拉着李大壮下了车，朝店内走去。

    “晴姐，不把葡萄卸下来吗？”李大壮看着占地至少二百平的超大水果店，很是惊讶，晴姐一个女人，竟然把水果店干的这么大，更别提还有别的分店了。

    这能力，和她性感的波涛一样，够大的！

    “不着急，咱们先去签协议！”徐晴回头暧昧一笑：“合同一签，你我才是真正的密不可分了~”

    玉手还在李大壮的手心挠了挠，惹得李大壮想入非非，也不知道这徐晴是不是天生的狐媚，明明没啥经验，咋这么会撩呢？

    “老板娘好！”

    徐晴刚进店，就有员工恭敬的跟她打着招呼。

    李大壮好奇的四处张望，看到一楼都是些常年的水果，只是品质一看就非常高，就连服务员都一个个条顺盘靓，清一色的秀气小美女！

    这些小美女也都好奇的偷瞄李大壮呢，以前都是别的男人追到店里来给老板娘送花求爱，这还是第一次见老板娘主动拉着男人的手回来呢！
content_en:
"Ugh!" Li Dazhuang felt hot all over his body. He wished he could push Xu Qing down immediately and deal with her on the sofa first!

    But Xu Qing smiled coquettishly and bumped him with the snow peak on her chest: "Little pervert, get down to business first, I don't know how to run away~~"

    "Sister Qing, I'm not young!" Li Dazhuang said dissatisfied.

    "Uh! Okay, okay! You're not young! You're the biggest~~" Xu Qing smiled even more happily, her beautiful eyes seemed to be able to draw threads, sticking tightly to Li Dazhuang's...

    This time it was Li Dazhuang's turn to feel embarrassed. He quickly put his legs together and covered...

    "What? You don't want me to see it? In Qingshui Town just now, I not only looked at it, but also touched it..."

    "Sister Qing, stop talking. Don't you want to sign a contract? Give me a pen!" Li Dazhuang's face turned red from her amusement and he quickly changed the subject.

    Unexpectedly, Xu Qing's smile became even more ambiguous: "Pen? What pen do you want...? Is it the one on the desk? Or the one on me..."

    "Sister Qing!" Li Dazhuang's voice was boiling. Why is this woman not shy at all? She is still a big girl after all. She dares to say anything: "The pen on your body can't write?"

    "Who said that!" Xu Qing glared at him, then reached out to her chest and pulled out a signature pen: "When I'm busy, I like to put my pen here. It's convenient to hold."

    "It's you, where were you thinking just now?"

    "I..." Li Dazhuang was completely speechless. I bet Xu Qing was not talking about that... pen!

    "Hehehe~ Da Zhuang, I found it so fun to tease you!" Xu Qing laughed so hard that her branches trembled, but she said: "Okay, I won't laugh at you anymore, but don't rush to sign, read it first!"

    "I've finished reading it, no problem!"

    "That's it? Didn't you just take a look at it?" Xu Qing finally stopped laughing and said seriously: "Dazhuang, I tell you, the contract is nothing else. It has legal effect if you sign it. If you sign without carefully reading the contents, you will easily be sold and you will help count the money!"

    "Sister Qing, I believe you won't be willing to sell me out, and I've really finished reading it. If you don't believe me, I'll give it to you!"

    Li Dazhuang really started to memorize the contents of the contract. Since Xu Qing really didn't want to cheat Li Dazhuang, there was not much in the contract, so he finished it in one breath!

    Xu Qing was stunned when she heard this: "Oh my god! Although I wrote these contents, I can't memorize them all. You actually memorized them all after just one glance. Are you a genius?"
title_en: Chapter 28 The excitement brought by clairvoyance
